summary: 43 units reviewed. 10 errors, 57 minor (60 machine patches; rest need a person or only confirm). No regrouping suggested. Text flags: uposṣitaḥ(54), abhyantarm(57), sadhana.strīn(74,76) confirmed; tuvarī.rāvāsya/āvāsya (64,79) kept but the draft's 'same slip' claim and the flag text are not established (āvāsya may be a real causative gerund of ā-√vas; gerund of ā-√vap would be āvapya); proposed new flags for apayāntu(51) and virāmati(60) need a person. Hindi patches follow GLOSSARY 14.3 (कृष्ण-चतुर्दशी, तीन रात उपवास किया हुआ, असंकीर्ण दाह-स्थान, सम्पात kept, no added और/तथा). Unit 86 absent from input, none invented.
